problem: Bare FLAC packet indexing parses canonical coded frame/sample numbers but discards them,constructing cumulative timestamps even if a checksum-valid stream contains clock gaps,overlap or changes blocking strategy.

reference.finding: A coded frame number equals the count of preceding frames; a coded sample number equals the count of preceding samples. Blocking strategy is constant within the audio stream.

requirements: Eleven checksum-valid streams must reproduce actual false file-clock admission,not a header CRC or PCM error.
Four legal streams retain literal PCM and worker play/rewind/seek/EOF,including variable block sizes,short final blocks and multi-byte numbers.
Keep independent single-frame codec decoding:only whole-stream structural clock contradictions must refuse.
Core and player regressions,related FLAC units/integrations,fixture reproduction and affected builds must pass.
